- Deposit authority applies to eleven original imported-strain assessments. Non-applicability for the other 369 is limited to that review scope and does not assert global culture absence or remove nomenclatural deposit evidence.
- The immutable source commit 049ac7442037cbb9af29619329a45d9af12874e5 is publicly retained by tag provenance-20261025T062431Z-review-batches-0014-0051; the commit SHA and input hashes are authoritative.
- All 760 original YAML/Markdown files remain byte-identical. This is a new linked observation; it does not edit original reviews, generated data/taxa records, generated pages, native curation history or the vendored contract.
- The source-snapshot and assertion-units scalar values contain JSON text under the existing ReviewDimension.value field; no new schema keys are introduced.
